correctStatements.text: At 12:10 Oluwaseun relayed creator complaints that uploads had been stuck on processing for over an hour.
At 12:15 Katarina saw 4,200 jobs in the transcode queue against a usual figure under 200.
Benedikt found the spot fleet had been reclaimed, dropping from 60 workers to 9.
At 12:24 Benedikt began falling back to on-demand instances for 40 workers.
At 12:35 Benedikt saw the on-demand workers come up, bringing the total to 49.
Miyu noted no data was lost but several creators missed their premiere slot because VODs were delayed.
At 12:55 Katarina saw the queue at 1,500 and falling at about 250 jobs per minute.
At 13:30 Katarina confirmed the queue had cleared.
At 13:36 Oluwaseun posted an update for creators and closed the incident.
Benedikt will keep a floor of 15 on-demand workers.
Miyu will draft an estimated wait message for the upload page.
Katarina summarised that reclaimed spot capacity left transcoding at a fraction of normal throughput for about 80 minutes.
